summary: Banco Santander (Brasil) S.A. filed a Form 6-K furnishing a synthetic remote voting map for an Extraordinary General Meeting scheduled for August 18, 2026. The agenda covers fixing the number of Board members, nominee elections, cumulative voting distribution, and a fiscal council request. The filing is a routine meeting notice and voting tabulation under CVM Resolution 81/22, with no special-situation event such as an acquisition, tender, restructuring, or management change. It is informational only, and no deal terms apply.
